structure: Part 8, check answers, declaration and confirmation. Read in full, under src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/features: check-answers (page.js, controller.js, template.njk, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, view-model/index.js, view-model/outstanding-parties.js, view-model/rows/change-link.js, summary-row.js, value-text.js, check-answers.fit.spec.js); declaration (page.js, controller.js, template.njk, copy.en.js, copy.cy.js, declaration.fit.spec.js); confirmation (page.js, controller.js, template.njk, copy.en.js, copy.cy.js, confirmation.fit.spec.js); review/evaluation.js and review/lateness.js; and obligations/sections/review.js. timing-windows.js was also read, only for the two day counts the lateness rules use. Pages covered: the check answers page at notification-view (three numbered sections of summary cards, change links, outstanding-party and origin errors, late warning, submit block, read-only submitted view with Delete, AMEND's Cancel amendment link and success banner); the declaration page at declaration (three statements, one confirmation checkbox, declaration date, Continue, submit and late-indicator stamping); the confirmation page at confirmation (panel with reference, body, notification date, late banner, two links). Also the lateness rule (potatoes 2 days before arrival, plants and wood 4 days after), the system obligation lateNotificationIndicator, and all 9 fit tests (3 check answers, 4 declaration, 2 confirmation). The slice stops at the dashboard the confirmation links to and at the delete and cancel-amend pages it links to.

claims.quote: test('shows an accessible submitted receipt, survives reload and links to the notification and dashboard'

claims.statement: Fit test: opening confirmation for a draft lands on check answers instead of a receipt.
claims.quote: test('returns a draft to check answers instead of showing a receipt'

claims.statement: A notification is on time if its arrival date is missing or not a real date.
Only potatoes, plants for planting, and wood and cut trees can be late; any other commodity type is always on time.
A potatoes notification is late when today (UK time) is after the day 2 days before arrival, so notifying 2 or more days ahead is on time and fewer than 2 days ahead is late.
claims.note: POTATO_DAYS_BEFORE_ARRIVAL = 2 in timing-windows.js, citing reg 24A(1).

claims.statement: A plants for planting or wood and cut trees notification is late when today (UK time) is more than 4 days after the arrival date.
claims.quote: potato ? -POTATO_DAYS_BEFORE_ARRIVAL : PLANTS_WOOD_DAYS_AFTER_ARRIVAL
claims.note: PLANTS_WOOD_DAYS_AFTER_ARRIVAL = 4 in timing-windows.js, citing reg 26(1).

claims.statement: The two timing windows (2 days before arrival for potatoes, 4 days after arrival for plants and wood) are set in one place and shared by the commodity type hints, arrival date validation and lateness rules.
claims.quote:
Both numbers are
 * written here and nowhere else — the commodity-type option hints, the
 * arrival-details validation and the lateness rules all read them from this
 * module rather than repeating the figure.

claims.statement: Lateness is judged against the request's clock, which a caller can supply so tests can set the date without changing global time.
claims.quote:
// One seam for each request; callers can supply a clock without changing global time.
export const requestClock = (request) => request.app?.clock?.() ?? new Date()

claims.statement: The notification records a late notification indicator with the value 'late' or 'on-time'.
claims.quote:
? 'late'
    : 'on-time'

claims.statement: The review section holds one obligation, lateNotificationIndicator: optional and set by the system, never asked of the user.
The review feature binds the stored lateNotificationIndicator answer to its obligation as a single value for evaluation.
The review obligation section declares no obligation for the declaration answer, although the declaration page collects 'declaration'.
claims.note: Looked in obligations/sections/review.js and review/evaluation.js only; a declaration obligation may be declared elsewhere in obligations/ (another part).
